label: Increased Security - No Delivery
applies_when: Security measures at a customer location prevent delivery; the package is not delivered and is returned to the station.
scope_notes: Examples include heightened security at military bases, power plants, and major events.

label: Incorrect Recipient Address
applies_when: The address on the label is incorrect, including when the recipient does not reside there or the address is invalid.
scope_notes: This differs from Code 003, where the listed address cannot physically be located.

label: Unable to Locate - Recipient Address
applies_when: The recipient address shown on the label or manifest cannot physically be located.
scope_notes: This differs from Code 002, where the address itself is incorrect or invalid.

label: Non-residential Recipient Not In
applies_when: A business recipient is not in and driver release is not permitted because of signature requirements, driver judgment, or no OP-201 on file.
scope_notes: Business or non-residential condition.

label: Package Refused by Recipient
applies_when: The recipient refuses to accept the package at delivery; current reviewed procedures also use it for a refused call tag and refusal to provide required ID for ASR or alcohol.
scope_notes: A refused call tag requires additional signatures, notation, and station check-in.
Valid ID that fails to scan uses a separate limited contingency.
locator: pages 33, 36, and 54, refusal procedures and Code 6

label: Residential Recipient Not In
applies_when: A residential delivery is attempted but the package cannot be released or delivered, including no recipient, a gated community, no secure release location, or no eligible adult with ID for ASR.
scope_notes: Signature-service restrictions still apply.
The call-tag procedure also uses Code 007 when a residential recipient is not home and did not leave the package.
locator: pages 34, 36, 46, and 53, residential recipient not in

label: Delivery to a Business
applies_when: A Home Delivery package is delivered to a business; FORGE applies the code automatically.
scope_notes: Automatically applied in FORGE.

label: Inspection Required
applies_when: A package has possible damage and is being returned to the station for inspection.
scope_notes: A leaking or hazardous package requires a separate safety procedure.

label: Non-residential Recipient Closed on Weekend
applies_when: A non-residential location is closed on Saturday; OP-117 describes the condition more broadly as a weekend closure.
scope_notes: Never use this delivery status for a residential recipient.
MGB-119 names Saturday specifically; OP-117 says weekend.
locator: page 2, Delivery Not Attempted, Code 011; OP-117 page 37, Code 11

label: Package Sorted to Wrong Route
applies_when: A package is found on the van after dispatch but should have been loaded to a different van.
scope_notes: The definition does not independently establish the complete package-disposition workflow.

label: Residential Delivery with Signature
applies_when: A package is delivered to a residence and a signature is obtained; FORGE applies the code automatically.
scope_notes: Automatically applied in FORGE.

label: Residence Driver Release
applies_when: A package is delivered to a residence without a signature and the release location is selected in FORGE.
scope_notes: Do not use when the package requires a signature or release is otherwise prohibited.

label: Holding Package
applies_when: The recipient requests that the package be held at the station for recipient pickup.

label: Package on Manifest, Not on Van
applies_when: The package appears on the FORGE or paper manifest but is not physically on the van.

label: Misdelivered Package Picked Up
applies_when: A package previously delivered to the wrong address is picked up.

label: Misdelivered Package Delivered to Correct Recipient
applies_when: A package previously delivered to an incorrect address is delivered to the correct recipient.

label: Indirect Delivery
applies_when: A package is delivered to an eligible alternate location or address because the recipient is not in and there is no safe place to leave it; FORGE applies the code automatically.
scope_notes: Not permitted for ASR, DSR, or appointment packages.

label: Business Driver Release
applies_when: A commercial recipient has a signed OP-201 Release Authorization Form on file authorizing release of a non-signature-required package.
scope_notes: The OP-201 must be filed at the station.
Does not authorize release of a signature-required package.

label: Call Tag Not Ready
applies_when: A call-tag package is not ready when pickup is attempted.
scope_notes: The reviewed detailed procedure applies when the driver cannot return later that day and requires signatures, code/time notation, and station handoff.
locator: pages 37 and 53, Code 24 and Call Tag FAQ

label: Tendered to U.S. Postal Service
applies_when: The package is given to the U.S. Postal Service for final delivery.

label: RTS Package - Delivered to Shipper
applies_when: A return-to-shipper package is delivered to the shipper.

label: Package Not Delivered - No Attempt
applies_when: The package is loaded on the van but no delivery attempt is made.
scope_notes: This definition does not by itself authorize skipping an attempt.

label: Tendered to Interline Carrier
applies_when: The package is given to an established interline carrier for final delivery.
scope_notes: MGB-119 labels the same code Tendered to Connecting Line Carrier.

label: Call Tag Package Pickup
applies_when: A call-tag package is successfully picked up and the call-tag label is securely placed on the package.
scope_notes: The label must cover old barcodes and addresses, and the recipient receives the top tab as the tracking receipt.
locator: pages 37 and 53, Code 29 and Picking up a Call Tag

label: Retail Refusal/O.S.A.
applies_when: MGB-119 lists this as a delivery attempted but not completed status named Retail Refusal/O.S.A.; the reviewed source does not define O.S.A. or its exact operating condition.
scope_notes: Definition only: do not select this code without current station guidance or a source defining the exact condition.
locator: page 2, Delivery Attempted but Not Completed, Code 030

label: Inventory/Request Future Delivery
applies_when: The package cannot be delivered because the recipient is closed for inventory, a new-store opening, or a similar situation.

label: Enroute Package Transfer
applies_when: A package is transferred to another route during the day after dispatch.

label: Contractor Refused Package
applies_when: A call-tag pickup is refused because of a service restriction, including hazmat, leakage, damage, inadequate packaging, or another acceptance restriction.
scope_notes: Hazardous material under a call tag must not be accepted and requires instructions from the original shipper.
locator: pages 38 and 53-54, Code 81 and Call Tag FAQ

label: Local Weather Delay
applies_when: A delivery attempt cannot be made because of an approved weather event such as flooding or snow.
scope_notes: The weather event must be approved.

label: Delivery Restriction/Local Holiday
applies_when: Delivery cannot be attempted because of an approved delivery restriction or a local holiday or event.
scope_notes: Examples include Mardi Gras or conventions; the restriction must be approved.

label: Transfer Custodial Control
applies_when: Packages are transferred to a hold location such as FedEx Office, Walgreens, or Dollar General; FORGE applies the code automatically when scanned at delivery.
scope_notes: MGB-119 labels this Intra-FedEx Transfer.

label: Customer Request - No Attempt Made
applies_when: CXPC sends a message that a delivery attempt should not be made; FORGE automatically applies the code for an on-road intercept.
scope_notes: Automatically applied by FORGE for the described intercept.

label: Unable to Hold at Location
applies_when: The package cannot be held at the selected hold location, such as FedEx Office, Walgreens, or Dollar General.

label: Tendered to Canada Post
applies_when: The package is tendered to Canada Post for final delivery to the recipient, excluding PO Box and Rural Route delivery addresses.
scope_notes: Canada-specific.

label: PO Box or Rural Route Canada Post
applies_when: The package is tendered to Canada Post for final delivery to a PO Box or Rural Route address.
scope_notes: Canada-specific.

label: Air Restricted Interline
applies_when: A package is transferred to the U.S. Postal Service in Alaska because its contents are air restricted.
scope_notes: Alaska-specific.

label: Future Delivery Requested at Pickup
applies_when: At pickup, the shipper requests that the package not be delivered before a specified future date and the date is captured at pickup.

label: Package Received After Cutoff
applies_when: The package is picked up after the ramp cutoff time.

label: International Paperwork Incomplete
applies_when: An international package is picked up with incomplete paperwork and requires intervention at the station.

label: Country/City Not Served
applies_when: A package is not picked up because FedEx does not serve the destination, whether temporarily or permanently.

label: Exceeds Service Limits
applies_when: A package is not picked up because it exceeds a service limit such as weight or dimensions.

label: Incorrect Pickup Information
applies_when: A dispatch has incorrect contact, request, or package-location information and the courier cannot locate the packages.

label: Attempted Pickup Left Behind
applies_when: A package is left behind because it fails package-acceptance standards, including leakage, damage, missing or improper paperwork, or an unacceptable payment method.

label: Payment Received for Duties and Taxes
applies_when: Payment for duties and taxes is collected while on road.
scope_notes: Available in FORGE only to Canada FedEx Express users.

label: FXE On-road Reroute
applies_when: An on-road automatic Redirect to Hold is performed; this is not the transfer scan.
scope_notes: Available in FORGE only to Canada FedEx Express users.

label: Unable to Collect Payment for Duties and Taxes
applies_when: Payment for duties and taxes cannot be collected while on road.
scope_notes: Available in FORGE only to Canada FedEx Express users.

label: Package Retrieval
applies_when: Packages are picked up after expiring at a hold location, or a misdelivered package is retrieved after the day it was misdelivered.

label: Pickup Payment Received
applies_when: Payment is received while picking up an Express package.
scope_notes: OP-117 says this FORGE option is not available in Canada or the United States.

label: Regulatory Agency Delay
applies_when: A package receives a Clearance or Broker Select Option intercept while on road; the code is applied automatically.
scope_notes: Automatically applied for the described intercept.

label: Security Delay - Waiting
applies_when: A customer security protocol delays but still allows delivery, such as a security line, escort, vehicle inspection, x-ray, or detection-dog check.
scope_notes: Applies to Express packages only and is informational only on Ground packages.
